camera_language: One continuous miniature Auckland world. Physical lens move / 3D dolly, matching horizon, block geometry, sheep position and green bag between shots. Static digital scaling is a PREVIS approximation only, never proof of a generated through-the-city camera track.

shot_camera.shot: family wishlist in same felt home
shot_camera.camera: close tabletop -> window glimpses the town; consistent city horizon
shot_camera.action: family opens list; wallet and CD-coin motif

shot_camera.camera: ground-level follow, behind the sheep; camera gently rises as it exits door
shot_camera.action: lamb runs with green bag and shovel

shot_camera.camera: start wide aerial showing harbour bridge + Sky Tower; s03 12.5s start physical zoom/dolly into one EXACT supermarket block
shot_camera.action: tiny lamb route is visible from above; no sudden teleport

shot_camera.camera: continue s03 camera's path and 3D geography, move from rooftop height to ground street level by ~16.5s, then follow lamb to pile
shot_camera.action: lamb enters same block seen overhead

shot_camera.camera: street close-medium as lamb digs; in last beat begin slight dolly backward while lamb packs coin (avoid cutting physical action)
shot_camera.action: two distinct shovel strokes; one blank coin later authentic CD postmark

shot_camera.camera: match s05 final camera position; dolly back revealing corner, pan WITH lamb across contiguous block; then gentle push toward cafe
shot_camera.action: lamb travels through space, no location reset

shot_camera.camera: closer cafe planter/sidewalk then gentle pull-out in last 0.7s
shot_camera.action: two distinct digs, second coin, sheep still in same bag/wardrobe

shot_camera.camera: carry pull-out over cafe rooftop, one connected lane to shopping street, then zoom back down to storefront
shot_camera.action: lamb runs through street, no appearance drift

shot_camera.camera: tight on shovel then pull slowly upward to see full street; no jump while coin emerges
shot_camera.action: two digs; third and only third new coin; same costume

shot_camera.shot: tiny lamb weaves through interconnected blocks
shot_camera.camera: UNBROKEN progressively widening crane/dolly out: storefront -> intersection -> roofline. Keep animated lamb visible and moving among blocks, not a static cut montage
shot_camera.action: full bag, tired feet, still mobile; route heads to family

shot_camera.camera: first 3.5s establish real handoff; from 53.5s camera keeps pulling up: family corner -> district -> whole Auckland
shot_camera.action: lamb gives bag to matching family, runs away. Start matching the world-to-globe shot before boundary.

shot_camera.shot: felt Earth revolves into canonical CityDiscount logo
shot_camera.camera: 55.0–56.0 globe occupies frame, city pin remains geographic anchor; spin 56.0–56.6 as sphere recedes/dissolves into EXACT real source Logo, no generated lettering; 56.6–60 Logo holds unchanged and tagline remains legible
shot_camera.action: brand payoff, avoid invented prices and retailer endorsements

transitions.anchor: same Auckland supermarket block, no street/roof teleport
sheep+green bag and same connected corner
same tiny moving sheep, follow footpath -> intersection -> roofs
family corner -> Auckland street grid -> mini city -> felt rotating globe
globe center transforms to center of canonical logo via protected source PNG
